data.name: EXORCIST K9
data.detailed_description:
A town swallowed by a sinister cult. A veteran Exorcist Agent gone silent.

Now, a rookie Paranormal Investigator and her partner—the Exorcism Hound—follow the traces he left behind, guided by a radio Handler, stepping into a dark and melancholy tragedy...

Exploration ADV & Stylish ACT

Welcome to the haunted house.

You can explore while being scared by paranormal phenomena.

Or, dash through bravely and scare the ghosts.

Creaking floors, flickering lights, ringing phones, brutal jump scares...

Whether you stop to watch the hauntings or ignore them and go take down the ghost, it’s all up to your playstyle.

Death Foresight & Instant Rewind

Touch the entrance door, and your extrasensory perception activates.

Dying inside means nothing—just a tragedy you foresaw before stepping through.

Instantly rewind to the front door, and break that death flag with a flawless run.

Exorcism Hound & Buddy Action

Issue commands to your canine companion with intuitive controls.

Bark to draw enemy attention, or track scents to uncover hidden mechanisms.

And of course, don’t forget to give them a good pat when things go well!

Gunplay & Environmental Interaction

Tricky ghosts stand in your way—dodging bullets, raising shields, or possessing shadows or nearby objects.

To drive them back, you’ll need more than just gunfire—make full use of every object around you.

Hide & Sensory Boost

Every time you burst from cover, your sharpened extrasensory perception slow the world to a crawl.

Outrun every fear, and clear the haunted house.

(Too fast to control? Cool down—or git gud.)

data.short_description: Breach the door, trust your extrasensory perception, and charge in with your Exorcism Hound! Slain by a ghost? No problem—that's a tragedy you foresaw! Rewind to the door and break that death flag! Tired of dying? Take a quiet stroll with your good boy... through a haunted house, anyway.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 or equivalent (2GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 or equivalent (4GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains violence. Players fight enemies (ghosts and creatures) using firearms, and hits produce blood and impact effects.
Horror elements such as jump scares and blood-related imagery (bloody writing, splatter, etc.) appear frequently. The ruined setting also includes recurring depictions suggesting death and tragedy.
